title: Launch Owner Pocket Brief
content:
Quick pocket brief for my head-in-the-game checklist before weekly release-train sync (personal notes / talking points / follow-ups).

Context and intent:
- Release: v2025.03.0 (hosted + dedicated rollout).
- Role: Launch owner — my job is to synthesize signals, call go/no-go for the staged rollout windows, and own comms to stakeholders.
- Goal for this week’s readout: confirm infra smoke, readiness of fallback model variant, and communications schedule.

Top 3 priorities to surface in the meeting:
1) Safety net: fallback model and automatic routing policy validated (can we route 5% to fallback on spike?).
2) Telemetry gating: synthetic traffic pass -- error rate <0.5% over 1h window; latency p50/p95 within SLO (hosted: p95 < 420ms).
3) External comms: coordinated release note + status channel + customer success prep.

Checklist (quick status to read aloud):
- Infra/beta cluster readiness: staging GPU pool up (ops says yes, cluster: staging-gpu-2), last deploy: 02/11 23:10 UTC — TODO: confirm model weights checksum in S3 (Ethan).
- Canary traffic plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 24h windows with automated rollback on error spike — TODO: add timeouts to the canary job (Marisol).
- Model variants: fp16 quantized variant validated on perf harness; quality delta measured on eval set (ROUGE-ish metrics): -0.8% on target prompts — note: acceptable per product.
- KV/cache warmup script: staging run completed; need to run warmup for first production rollout (Diego).
- Monitoring/alerts: new alert rule for prefix-cache miss (>10% over 10m) added to SRE dashboard; verify Slack escalation P1 route.

Open risks (to call out):
- Risk A: Edge-case hallucination found in NLU regression test for prompts with nested JSON — severity medium. Mitigation: add prompt filter for known pattern + increase sampling in QA. Need decision: ship with mitigation or revert model patch? (Action: Priya to convene mini-CR).
- Risk B: Dedicated capacity quota borderline in eu-west-1 — we may not be able to scale burst to 2x on day 0. Ops request: confirm reserved buffer or move some traffic to other region. (Action: Ethan to confirm reserve by EOD Thur).
- Risk C: Billing spike detection not fully wired for deduped tokens; short term alert exists but not annotated with customer tags. Could cause late notification to finance. (Action: Marisol to add tags / assign owner).

Decision points for the meeting (explicit asks):
- Accept quality regression threshold (-1.0% on eval) for this release? Product needs to sign off. (Product rep: Marisol).
- Approve canary ramp schedule (1->5->20). If not approved, fallback plan = 1% -> hold -> re-evaluate.
- Greenlight the customer-facing release note and staggered announcement (opt-in customers night of 03/02).

Talking points / script for the sync (my notes):
- "Two minute high level": release summary, what changes (latency improvements, model variant, cost delta), and why we’re doing staged rollout.
- "Risks & mitigations": list the top 3 bullets above, call owners and expected ETA for fixes.
- "Gate criteria": infra up, telemetry checks pass, product sign-off on quality delta, CS readiness confirmed.
- "Call to action": if all green, go-no-go vote; if any red, propose next steps.

Pre-meeting asks (things I will check before 1:1 with SRE/infra):
- Confirm final SHA and model S3 path (via GH deploy PR #342).
- Check last 6h of staging logs for any OOM / retry patterns. (Diego to share grep output).
- Validate SLA alert escalation path: on-call contact and runbook link present.

Immediate follow-ups (post-sync action items I will carry):
- Create a short incident channel template for the rollout (Slack channel pinned message + stakeholders) — aim to post before canary start.
- Draft the release note (first pass) and hand to Marisol for tone and CS copy.
- Run an ad-hoc eval on the 500-sample prompt set flagged during regression — escalate if >1.2% failure.

Personal reminders (notes to self):
- Don’t get pulled into infra debugging in the sync; collect log snippets and escalate to Diego/infra.
- Keep the meeting to 30 minutes — use parking-lot for deep dive.
- After decision, schedule a 15m follow-up for ops handover and comms.

Meeting logistics / context lines to include in calendar invite:
- Weekly release-train sync: Thu 09:00 PT / 17:00 UTC. Attendees: Release owner, Infra lead, SRE on-call, Product manager, QA lead, CS lead, Observability owner.
- Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/LAUNCH-2025-03/runbook
- Slack channel: #launch-v2025-03 (I’ll create pinned checklist).

Notes for after the meeting (keep for postmortem):
- Timestamp decisions and owners in the ticket JIRA-OPS-1122.
- Capture any unexpected manual steps required during canary — those become next-week action items.
- If we deviate from the planned ramp, note why and whether automation can avoid the manual intervention next time.

Random scratch items (brain dump):
- Confirm whether we should include dedicated customers in opt-in night or keep them in reserved window. Product leaning toward reserved only.
- Consider a short FAQ for CS for the top-5 expected questions.
- Double-check compliance checklist for Private customers (audit log retention policy) — might need sign-off from security.

Bottom line for the call: present a crisp yes/no on the go/no-go criteria, with clear owners for any unresolved items and target times for resolution.

--- end pocket brief ---

(Will update this doc after the meeting with final decisions and the trimmed action list.)
